summary.name: The Practice of System and Network Administration
summary.one_liner: A "last post" blog entry from the Everything Sysadmin site marking the 20th anniversary of the first edition of The Practice of System and Network Administration, a vendor-agnostic sysadmin book by Tom Limoncelli and co-authors.
keywords: the practice of system and network administration
use_cases: Finding sysadmin textbooks for university courses
Reading about process and people in IT operations
Buying the 3rd edition or cloud sequel at a discount
summary.what_it_does: The page is a blog post by Tom Limoncelli marking twenty years since the first edition of The Practice of System and Network Administration shipped in 2001. It lists the book's later editions (2nd in 2006, 3rd in 2014) and a sequel, The Practice of Cloud System Administration. The author describes the book as vendor-agnostic, focused on process and people rather than specific tools and operating systems. The post reports sales of tens of thousands of copies, use as a university textbook, and the USENIX LISA Outstanding Achievement Award. It also announced a publisher discount of 45% off the latest editions until Oct 31, 2021.
notable: Vendor-agnostic book focused on process and people rather than specific tools
Received the USENIX LISA Outstanding Achievement Award
Used as a university textbook; 3rd edition adds dozens of new chapters
Companion sequel: The Practice of Cloud System Administration
caveats: The 45% discount was time-limited and ended Oct 31, 2021
Book editions are sold for a price; the page does not state specific prices
